meta.notes: All image generation MUST prepend the style_prefix to the prompt. To change the global visual style, edit STYLE_PREFIX in: scripts/pregenerate.cts, scripts/pregen-images.cts, src/app/api/image/route.ts, and src/app/api/chat/route.ts. To change the TTS voice/pronunciation, edit the same files (or src/lib/venice.ts).
meta.slug_dedup_note: 7 Gujarati letters share a roman slug with another letter (ta, tha, da, dha, na, la, sha — each appears twice with different example words). The pregenerate script generates one file per UNIQUE slug, so the on-disk count is 141 images/audio files (not 148). The duplicate letter entries are listed in the 'letters' array below with a 'duplicate_slug_of' marker.
